name: Orbiting Hearts
author: Amyang
description: Heart outlines drifting around the center. Transparent between the lines — a worked example of a decoration layer over your background color.

name: Quiet Rain
author: Amyang
description: Thin rain streaks in two curtains, one hanging behind the cast and one in front, so the silhouette cuts the far drops while the near ones pass over it. Low-alpha and cool — mood, not weather simulation.

name: REZE DESIGN
author: Amyang
description: A flickering neon sign spelling REZE DESIGN — glyphs are plain line segments with an exponential glow. Transparent around the tubes.

name: Shining Stars
author: Amyang
description: A twinkling starfield that pans with the camera. Transparent between stars — your background color (or image) stays the sky.

name: Fireworks
author: Amyang
description: Eight shells on a rotation, no two the same size: each climbs on an eased arc, bursts into a fan that falls away under gravity trailing hot streaks, and about two in five of those sparks crackle again into embers. Ported from Gatomoi. SPEED slows the whole display, BOOM sizes the burst, TRAIL is how long the streaks run, PARTICLES is the cost dial.

name: Ground Mist
author: Amyang
description: Mist integrated along the view ray rather than sampled off the floor, so the cast stands INSIDE it and the air in front of them veils them. Pooled in world space around the scene, with two noise layers shearing to raise and lower its surface. POOL is how far it spreads, TOP how deep it stands, STEPS the cost dial.

name: Ripples
author: amyang-xyz
description: Rings on the floor centred on whoever is standing there, following the cast as they walk and fading as they jump clear of it. The worked example for bgSubjectPos — an effect that responds to the scene rather than decorating the frame.

name: Halo
author: amyang-xyz
description: A ring of light standing in the world over every head, parented to the 頭 bone. A real torus, so it keeps its thickness seen edge-on instead of collapsing the way a flat disc does.

name: Hand Ribbon
author: amyang-xyz
description: A neon ribbon along the path each hand actually took, with stars twinkling along it. The worked example for rzTrail — the path itself, sampled on the scene clock, rather than one segment guessed from a velocity.

name: Footprints
author: amyang-xyz
description: Marks where the feet met the ground, left behind and burning out as the character walks away. The worked example for reading rzTrail in world space — the samples near the floor ARE the contacts, and their age is how long ago each happened.
